user.title: Connect to Dispatcharr
user.description: Enter your Dispatcharr URL and account credentials. They're used to mint a permanent API key for regular requests, and are also stored so the optional websocket link can silently re-authenticate (Dispatcharr's websocket only accepts short-lived JWTs, not the API key).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Dispatcharr
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key was rejected by Dispatcharr. Enter your username and password again to mint a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Dispatcharr with these details. Check the URL and credentials.

data_description.enable_epg: Look up the currently airing program for each active stream. Disable for better performance on slower servers.
data_description.enable_realtime: Keep a websocket connection open so stream/recording/notification changes push an update immediately instead of waiting for the next poll. Note: live stream-status events are only sent to Dispatcharr admin accounts.
data_description.update_interval: How often to poll Dispatcharr for active streams, from 2 to 300 seconds. Lower is closer to real-time but puts more load on your server. Realtime updates (above) still arrive immediately regardless of this value.
